description: United Distributors Pakistan Limited was set up in 1981 to distribute agricultural inputs, and worked as distribution partner and later joint-venture partner for Dow AgroSciences, FMC and Pioneer in Pakistan. It now develops and sells its own portfolio of crop protection chemicals, fertilisers and micronutrients, with a formulation plant in Karachi, warehouses in all four provinces, and suppliers in China, Thailand, Turkey and Germany.
headOffice: 92-C, Jami Commercial Street 11, Phase VII, Defence Housing Authority, Karachi
